Ido

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

debatir

  1. past infinitive of debatar

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /debaˈtiɾ/ [d̪e.β̞aˈt̪iɾ]
  • Audio (Venezuela):(file)
  • Rhymes: -iɾ
  • Syllabification: de‧ba‧tir

Verb

[edit]

debatir (first-person singular present debato, first-person singular preterite debatí, past participle debatido)

  1. (transitive) to debate
  2. (reflexive) to struggle (in a decision)
